# ndsplugin

Nintendo **DS** music (`.2sf` / `.mini2sf`).

Extensions: `.2sf` `.mini2sf`

## Engine

kode54's **vio2sf** — the ARM7/ARM9 + NDS sound-hardware core. The vendored copy
uses the reentrant `state_*` form and is built with `-DNO_ASM`.

## Build gating

**ChipMachinePlus only** — see [`LEGAL-PLUS`](../../../../../LEGAL-PLUS).
